subject: dolphin
name: 海豚
label: 弯弯的小海豚
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One dolphin side silhouette in a gentle C-shaped leap, rounded snout, one dorsal fin and broad forked tail.
Pure black contour drawing with completely blank interiors. No hatching, shading or gray fills. Complete connected anatomy. Keep the whole subject centered within the middle 75 percent of the image, clear margins on all sides.
